title: India cold chain logistics is a **$12B** market growing at **14% CAGR**, providing the scale and momentum to support platform investment
subtitle: Current scale and sustained expansion are both large enough to underwrite platform build-out.

chart.annotation: The market expands from $12B in 2024 to $21B by 2028 at 14% CAGR.

insights.text: The market starts at **$12B**, giving investors immediate scale rather than a niche entry point.
Growth at **14% CAGR** supports multi-year capacity deployment and platform expansion.
The trajectory reaches **$21B** by 2028, indicating a larger revenue pool for scaled operators.
